observation_summary: The CSV parser reports an incorrect line number (0 instead of 1) when processing input separated by carriage returns.
reasoning_summary: The bug report and failing test indicate that the CSV parser fails to increment the line number when encountering a carriage return (CR) as a line terminator. The ExtendedBufferedReader class, which is responsible for reading the input, only explicitly handles line feed (LF) characters for line counting. Because the parser does not recognize CR as a valid line separator for incrementing the internal line counter, the line number remains at 0 after reading the first record, causing the assertion failure in the test.
